title: What if you could read minds? But there's a catch.
idea: There's a catch, episode 6: Spud can suddenly read minds at a casino poker table; he wins everything, then the power spreads to every guest, the street and the whole city, and he loses it all because he can't find the one thought that matters

visible.why: frame 0: Wedge shoves a huge heap and his gold watch into the pot, the crowd round the table, Spud with three chips left
Wedge leans in, smug: trust me; Spud gulps, sweating
over Spud's shoulder: his two cards, the 3 of clubs and the 3 of diamonds; Wedge's heap past them
over Wedge's head a bubble: his real cards, the 8 and the 3, a bluff; Wedge still grins
Spud slaps his threes face up, Wedge has to show 8 and 3; Spud rakes the pot in, the crowd cheers
a bubble over every friend: cards, pizza, a phone; Spud grins behind stacks as tall as his chest
a mountain of chips towers beside Spud, arms up; the crowd amazed
his smile gone: a bubble pops up over every guest, more and more
the casino packed wall to wall with bubbles; Spud's gloves on his head, eyes squeezed shut
Wedge slams his car keys down; Spud pushes through the bubbles over Wedge's head, can't find his thought, pushes it all in
from above: four aces (two in Wedge's hand, two on the board) beat Spud's kings; Wedge drags the mountain away
Spud slumps, empty gloves, the bubbles still everywhere
night: Spud walks down a busy neon street, gloves on his head; a bubble over every passer-by and in every window
the neon city from above: a glowing bubble over every roof and window, thousands
night, a hotel room high above the city: Spud awake, pillow on his head, the thoughts streaming in
